postUpgradeTasks.description:
Regenerate terraform.md after a dependency bump. Each module's Providers table renders the version CONSTRAINT from its provider.tf, so a bare `~> 8.0` -> `~> 9.0` bump staleness the docs in every module using that provider and CI's terraform-docs job fails the PR (#50, 13 modules at once). Renovate has no way to infer that, so the generator has to re-run.

The command must match the allowlist regex in the shared renovate.yml workflow's `allowed_commands` byte for byte -- postUpgrade shell is refused unless the SELF-HOSTED config allowlists it, and a repo's renovate.json cannot authorize its own commands. That allowlist has always named this exact path; the script is what was missing.

executionMode is `branch` rather than the default `update`: the script regenerates all six provider directories whatever changed, so running it once per branch instead of once per upgrade is strictly cheaper on a grouped PR.
